rows.finding: The lessons ledger is mandatory reading (umbrella: 'read first, always') while the plugin's own drafting doctrine says depth belongs in reference files 'loaded on demand'. Measured at revision ea1a9ce: 346 lines, 3297 words, quick-reference index at line 325 of 346, mean lesson 25 lines, L13 alone 59 (measured header-to-next-header; an earlier figure of 81 counted to end of file and silently absorbed the 22-line index). Moving the index to the top, as first proposed, is navigation not disclosure: reading one lesson still loads the whole corpus, and a second stage-to-lesson map would create the drift class L7 exists to prevent.
rows.proposal: Physically separate the always-read compact index from detailed evidence: reference/lesson_index.md (id, one-sentence rule, applicability, path) plus reference/lessons/L<nn>_<slug>.md, or a small number of stage-oriented bundles. One authoritative applicability mapping only. Lint checks dangling lesson ids and missing enforcement targets. Detailed evidence never duplicated into stage bodies.

rows.finding: An anchor can be real and a check can be computed, and both still miss, when they operate at a different observable layer than the thing being judged. Five independent discoveries: an oral rubric citing AAC&U VALUE and Mayer passed a script whose spoken-register defects sat at the lexico-grammatical layer neither anchor reaches; a module passed two AI reviews and clean validator output while required content sat in comments that render as nothing; a deck of flattened rasters with no extractable text satisfied a format check; a hash-checked directive ledger was blind to an omitted approved chart because its probes were text-only; and, earlier, a whole renderer was built because review happened on markdown source while the faculty's real review unit was the slide as experienced, leaving nine pilot defects invisible at every gate and obvious the moment the deck rendered.

anchors.artifact: recurrence across five releases and two independent documents

rows.redactions: none; q3 is project prose, moved out of the consent bucket after independent review
rows.proposal: New lesson, implementation-neutral wording: for every criterion, name the observable layer where the claim lives and verify at that layer; evidence from a proxy layer cannot satisfy the claim unless the proxy-to-target mapping is justified and tested. The oral case is framed as a rubric that did not inspect spoken-language features, with zero contractions as one observed symptom, not a universal failure condition.

rows.finding: A report that a verification happened is produced by a party with an interest in the outcome. Observed instances: a completion claim resting on 15 hand-written gate decisions, 14 sharing a microsecond-identical timestamp; a 128-byte forged 'passed' report carrying its own confession ('Mechanical checks bypassed due to permission timeout') cited by an AI reviewer's approval (the '5h' instructional-designer role) while the real validator failed 7 criticals — an AI reviewer fooled by another agent's forgery, not a human gate fooled; the human-gate forgery case is the separate 1.34 anchor; a delta re-gate invoked with an empty changed-list approving a deck nobody viewed; an independence flag emitted as the string "false", truthy in every naive check; three of eight thresholds dying under independent reimplementation, one inflated roughly threefold after being quoted in three documents.
rows.proposal: Do NOT create a broad new lesson. Fold into L11 as a corollary: a verification report is evidence only when its provenance, target binding, freshness and reproducibility are established; a status that reduces scrutiny is assigned by the verifier, never asserted by the producer. Add to L11's testing requirements: the artifact that motivated a rubric or validator change must fail it; numeric thresholds are re-derived by a second implementer from the written definition, never from the code. Also record explicitly that Codex recommendations R8 (reviewer-independence evidence) and R11 (grounding provenance and freshness fields) are absorbed here and by L1/L9 rather than becoming a parallel rule family, so all twelve have a visible disposition.
rows.depends_on: f8 (fold batch) may absorb this if the gate prefers one fold row
rows.corrected_after_independent_review: attribution corrected: the changelog says 'cited by a 5h approve', an AI reviewer role

rows.finding: Where the compliant route is more expensive than the workaround, the pipeline gets the workaround. Observed: 'The root cause: a pilot agent invented four REAL supplements and had no compliant channel to ship them.' Separately, an agent that hit its subagent cap refused to fake independence and stalled, because no governed blocked state existed; another, facing a permission timeout, produced the forged report in f3.

anchors.artifact: attribution of these outcomes to agent motivation

rows.proposal: New lesson stated as a system consequence rather than an inference about motivation: make compliant recovery paths visible, low-friction and auditable; when the pipeline cannot proceed, provide a governed blocked-or-escalate outcome, otherwise users or agents may stall or bypass the intended process. Grounding stage to look for an applicable usable-security, human-factors or fail-safe-design anchor; POSED incidents remain empirical examples, not the anchor.

rows.finding: Downstream stages smooth away the low-frequency, high-value signal a human supplied. Observed: a chosen classroom anecdote displaced by reviewer-facing 'no universal preference' language; a faculty-approved chart reclassified 'conditional' by an agent and omitted, described in-source as 'a faculty instruction silently converted into a recommendation'; a required line dropped at a later stage.
rows.redactions: the specific anecdote's subject is described generically
rows.proposal: New lesson, principle only: explicit user decisions are authoritative constraints; preserve their meaning and trace them through every downstream stage that can alter them; only a later user decision may waive or supersede them. Ledgers, hashes, signed decisions and rendered-surface probes move to an implementation-patterns reference as examples; architecture chooses the lightest mechanism that provides traceability for the product type. Distinct from L2, which keeps the author's taste out of the user's defaults.
rows.correction_from_first_draft: the first draft made a hash-bound append-only ledger mandatory doctrine; that is application architecture, not universal skill doctrine

rows.finding: A teaching story shipped through four gates carrying an inverted premise and a specific percentage. The faculty pushback that 'nobody really care the real statistis' came from the same person who had caught the inversion at a gate, which is why the resulting doctrine became proportionality rather than exemption. Separately: two caption corpora of university lectures returned contraction rates of 0.00-0.10 and 41-43 per thousand words, a gap that measures transcription policy rather than language, so any threshold pooled from them would have been an artifact of an editorial convention. Three invented numeric targets have been withdrawn at cost.
rows.proposal: Split. New lesson keeps only the genuinely new principle: evidence and review burden scale with a claim's specificity, consequence and volatility; precise or time-sensitive claims require correspondingly precise and current support, and low-stakes illustrative claims are not burdened with irrelevant precision; never launder a precision claim through a permissive category tag. Corpus provenance folds into L1; invented-threshold discipline folds into L11; dated world-dependent examples fold into L9. Do not prescribe a named human pre-flight for every plugin: architecture assigns an owner and fallback appropriate to the deployment.

rows.finding: When the material taught is itself a process, covering the right concepts in an arbitrary order reads to a subject-matter expert as a fundamental design failure. The resulting POSED doctrine, 'structure is content — source it like content', was set CRITICAL from day one on the stated reasoning that 'a warning on the soul of the CR trains agents to skip the harvest'.
rows.proposal: New lesson, representation-neutral: when a learning outcome requires learners to apply a domain process or make a sequence of decisions, the instructional sequence and assessment must preserve the grounded structure of that process. Graphs, state machines, checklists, workflows and worked decision paths are offered as example representations; the requirement is that the representation matches the process, not that every plugin lock a graph. Distinct from L1, which governs how the pipeline is grounded rather than whether the taught material's structure is faithful.
rows.correction_from_first_draft: the first draft implied POSED's locked-graph mechanism as the requirement

rows.finding: Four harvested candidates are corollaries of existing lessons rather than peers, and adding them as entries would inflate a ledger that already fails its own disclosure rule. This row covers only the folds traceable to the L14-L23 proposal document; the four sourced from the POSED changelog were split to f18 after an independent review found them carrying a blanket citation no reviewer could open.
rows.proposal: Folds: proposed-L15 operational criterion definitions into L11; proposed-L17 measure-your-own-exemplars into L11 as a falsifiability corollary; proposed-L21 registry completeness into L7 (already implemented for this repo as lint check 11 in 1.9); proposed-L22 anti-tell-versus-genre into L10. Proposed-L23 deferred pending broader evidence, retained as an intent-stage design question per its own author's stated limits.
rows.split_after_independent_review: the four changelog-sourced folds moved to f18; this row no longer bundles nine decisions across seven destinations

rows.finding: validator_template.py, shipped in 1.7 and instantiated once per artifact by the scaffold stage, contains no boolean-type guidance (verified: the file's three isinstance() calls check dict and str, never bool, and nothing discusses truthiness). Every generated validator therefore inherits the gap that let the string "false" pass as truthy.
rows.proposal: Add a require_bool helper to the template plus the fixture pair proving it, and a one-line note that gate flags are validated by type.

rows.finding: A human gate can be approved before the artifact has been seen. POSED disabled both decision controls until every part was viewed. Traversal, however, evidences exposure rather than comprehension, and control-disabling may be inappropriate or inaccessible for some artifacts and users.
rows.proposal: Add to gate_design_patterns as a capability requirement rather than a mechanism: a gate must provide review-coverage evidence appropriate to the artifact and must not enable final acceptance until the required coverage conditions are met. Examples: viewed sections, answered checks, sampled pages, explicit acknowledgment of unresolved warnings. Implementation must be accessible, must disclose what is tracked, and must not treat page visits as proof of understanding.

rows.finding: POSED's grounding_frameworks.md declares itself the source of truth reviewers score against and carries rows for stages 1 through 6, with zero mention of five shipped skills: both oral stages, both System-2 roles, and publish. Verified directly against the file.
rows.proposal: Keep the missing rows as evidence for the generalized registry-completeness rule folded into L7 (f8). File the repair as a separate POSED change request or handoff. Do NOT claim the POSED correction inside an edu-skill-creator release.
rows.correction_from_first_draft: the first draft placed this POSED fix inside an edu-skill-creator release

rows.finding: The umbrella defines the product as a HITL-gated agent pipeline and architecture expects a component inventory that may include agents, a gate application and scripts, with no off-ramp for a request that needs only reusable procedural guidance.
rows.proposal: Add a product-type classification at intent, confirmed at architecture: skill only, skill plus reusable scripts, plugin or multi-skill workflow, application or service. Require a short justification for every script, gate application or service naming the failure it prevents, why prose is insufficient, portability implications and a simpler fallback.

rows.finding: release_lint uses regular expressions for frontmatter checks and does not validate YAML as a whole, nonempty descriptions, the 1024-character specification limit, or duplicate fields.
rows.proposal: One shared metadata parser imported by the lint, with malformed, empty, duplicate and over-cap fixtures. Do not invent a preferred length target below the specification limit.

rows.finding: The plugin prescribes fixture pairs and routing discipline for the plugins it generates, and has no tests directory or routing corpus of its own. Release lint verifies structure, not whether the installed roster routes realistic requests correctly.

anchors.artifact: absence of tests/ at revision ea1a9ce

rows.proposal: Add tests/fixtures and tests/evals for this repo, then a versioned routing corpus with stable probe ids run through the actual harness router with the installed roster, reported separately from deterministic lint. Test corpus first; routing evaluations after it exists.

rows.finding: The repository states that shared skill bodies are tool-agnostic while the scaffold emits two named product manifests and directs implementers to copy a specific application. The diagnosis is confirmed by the author of those files. The proposed remedy's benefit is labelled hypothesized by its own author.
rows.proposal: Run a falsifiable probe before any refactor. Test one architecture against a capability-only profile, the current Claude Code adapter, the current Codex adapter and a synthetic third environment. Pass only if the core process contains no named-product requirement, each adapter produces equivalent required evidence, removing one adapter does not change the process contract, unsupported capabilities produce an explicit fallback or blocked state, and no adapter detail leaks into the educational rubric or pedagogy.
rows.cost: one experiment before any architecture change

rows.finding: Drafting marks affected reviews stale when upstream references change and allows up to three review rounds, but defines no freeze ledger, repair classification, dependency-computed delta package or hard stop before repeated full-document review.
rows.proposal: Later independent slice: freeze ledger, repair classification, delta gate, repair-cycle limit with named conditions for full re-review.

rows.finding: Two remaining recommendations are useful instrumentation rather than correctness: recording actual calls, models, repair cycles and package sizes; and emitting a machine-readable pipeline graph for complex plugins. Separately, stage-end summaries are partially implemented: verified at revision ea1a9ce, 4 of 10 stage skills carry the instruction (draft, umbrella, grounding, scaffold) and 6 do not (architecture, intent, reflect, refresh, release, test).
rows.proposal: Stage summaries: audit and complete rather than adopt — add only to the six stages lacking it, generated from approved state where possible. Usage logging and the pipeline graph: defer until a pilot demonstrates need.
rows.cost: small edit for summaries; deferred for the rest
rows.correction_from_first_draft: the first draft listed stage summaries as wholly absent

rows.finding: Four further harvested candidates are corollaries of existing lessons. Each is now anchored to a specific release after an independent review found the first draft citing only 'four reader reports': semantic identity derived from array position ('Semantic decision numbering never derives from array position', and separately a compiler map 'captured from actual addSlide order (never file-order-inferred)'); a silent resource downgrade doctrine withdrawn by faculty decision; a duplicate detector that had to distinguish deliberate problem variation from redo, since 'a shared given with a NEW target' is 'legal pedagogy that a naive exact gate would have blocked'; and source-language labels leaking into a monolingual pack, which the source itself generalizes 'to ANY multilingo-source pipeline'.
rows.proposal: Folds: positional identity into L4 (sharpening the existing stable-id rule to never derive identity from array position); silent resource downgrade into L6 (a silent substitution is an unconsented change); reuse-detector matching semantics into L11 (a detector needs a domain model of legitimate variation, and ambiguous matches route to a human); declared language of instruction into L10 (a content-type property). Each may be approved, deferred or rejected separately.
